126
Two-laning of roads in hilly areas
*401. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
5,000 kms. for two-laning in remote hilly
areas in the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the projects that would be taken up for
two-laning in Orissa?
Mumbai Port Trust
*402. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Maharashtra have sought
direction to Mumbai Port Trust to work
jointly with the former for preparation of
land development plan of eastern part of
Mumbai city’s Port Trust land;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken in the matter?
Financial assistance for sports
infrastructure  to Sikkim
*403. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA: Will the
Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any financial assistance is
being granted to the State of Sikkim for
sports infrastructure development; and
(b) if so, the details thereof during the
last three years alongwith the incentives
being given to sportspersons like Bhai
Chung Bhutia, India’s Football captain?

127
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Housing projects in urban centres
*404. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of  HOUSING AND
URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is huge
demand for housing projects in the urban
centres;
(b) if so, whether Government are
planning to study land management in urban
areas;
(c) the number of homeless living in
jhuggi-jhonpris in major cities in the
country; and
(d) whether there is any plan with
Government to provide housing to them?
Campaign to protect ‘Ramsetu’
†*405. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the Minister of  OVERSEAS INDIAN
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether, to protect ‘Ramsetu’, any
campaign has been launched by
Ishavasyamind of America, a Hindu Forum
of Britain and Global Human Rights
Defence of the Netherlands;
(b) whether they have also raised
questions concerning environment and
safety on Sethusamudram project; and
(c) whether it is also a fact that they
have advised to consider the post-tsunami
figures?
Gram Pradhan Nidhi
†*406. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of  PANCHAYATI
RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are in favour
of providing more powers to Gram
Pradhans for strengthening the Panchayati
Raj;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government are considering
to provide “Gram Pradhan Nidhi” for Gram
Pradhans for the development of villages
on the lines of “MPLADS”;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Indian tourists missing in Spain
†*407. SHRI SHATRUGHAN
SINHA: Will the Minister of  EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether India-based Embassy of
Spain has provided any information on 140
Indian tourists that have gone missing during
travel to Spain;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken by Government in
this regard?
Sealing of unauthorised commercial
premises
†*408. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of  URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that sealing of
unauthorised commercial premises is still
going on even after announcement of new
Master Plan 2021 for the State of Delhi
and general elections to Municipal
Corporation of Delhi;

128
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) whether Government have
ascertained the number of those illegal
commercial premises which are to be sealed;
and
(c) if so, the total number of such
premises?
Powers to PRIs under the
Constitution
*409. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of  PANCHAYATI
RAJ be pleased to state:
(a) the real situation in various States
with reference to Articles 243, 243-A to
243-0 as far as powers to Panchayati Raj
Institutions are concerned;
(b) the State-wise details in this regard;
and
(c) the action proposed against the
States which have not transferred various
statutory functions to the Panchayats?
Underground fire in Jharia-Dhanbad
area
†*410. SHRI AJAY MAROO : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Bharat Coking Coal Limited
(BCCL) has written any letter to the
Ministry of Coal regarding accidents of
caving-in of land due to underground fire in
the Jharia-Dhanbad area;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the indifferent attitude of
the State Government has been mentioned
in this letter; and
(d) if so, the action being taken by
Government in this regard?
Monitoring of telecom companies by
TRAI
*411. SHRI S. M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that private mobile
telecom companies are not passing on
proper tariff rates to subscribers;
(b) whether it is also a fact that TRAI
fixes charges for calls, roaming and diverse
other services;
(c) in what way TRAI monitors telecom
companies to ensure that the actual bills
reflect the stated charges;
(d) whether customers are being fleeced
by large telecom companies; and
(e) the steps proposed by TRAI to
randomly check bills and inspect suddenly
the high charges and complicated bills being
issued which puzzle the customers?
Concession in rentals under ‘One
India’ plan
*412. SHRI RAJEEV CHANDRA-
SEKHAR: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether concession in rentals is
granted by BSNL and MTNL to various
categories of consumers;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that the same
concession is not available to the consumers
who have taken ‘One India’ connection or
have switched over to that plan from other
schemes;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor;

129
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) whether both, BSNL and MTNL,
propose to extend this concession under
‘One India’ plan also;
(f) if so, by when a decision to that
effect is likely to be taken; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Amount sanctioned for
Commonwealth Games
†*413. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to spend an amount of
Rs. 7000 crores on organizing the
Commonwealth Games, 2010;
(b) if not, the facts thereof;
(c) the amount out of the said total
amount proposed to be spent by
Government for boosting playing
capability and efficiency of the players;
and
(d) the names of sources through which
this amount would be spent togetherwith
the heads under which the remaining
amount has been decided to be spent, head-
wise separately?
Medals won by sportspersons in
National Games
†*414. SHRI AJAY SINGH
CHAUTALA: W ill the Minister of
YOUTH AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of talented
sportspersons of the country awarded with
medals in the National Games held in
Guwahati in February this year; and
(b) as per the sports policy of the State
the number of persons from Haryana
alongwith the number of medals won by
them?
Short supply of coal
*415. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether there is short supply of
coal and the coal mines are not able to meet
the requirements of the power plants;
(b) if so, the demands received and the
supplies made during each of the last two
years to power plants;
(c) the reasons for the short supply, if
any; and
(d) the measures taken to meet the
demand?
Sethusamudram project endangering
link between India and
Sri Lanka
†*416. PROF. RAM DEO
BHANDARY:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that existence of
remains of Sri Ram Setu, constructed in
ancient times between India and Sri Lanka,
have been verified by the satellites of NASA;
(b) whether it is also a fact that consequent
upon construction of "Sethusamudram
Project", which links India with Sri Lanka,
existence of 30 km. long Sri Ram Setu of
ancient times would be lost and would become
a matter of history; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

130
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Performance of serving bureaucrats
*417. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to get the performance of its serving
bureaucrats evaluated by the faculty of
foreign institutes like MIT, Harvard,
Princeton and Yale;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether the serving IAS personnel
would also undergo refresher courses in
such universities to finetune their skills in
governance and decision making?
VPTs under Bharat Nirman
Programme
†*418. SHRIMATI SUSHMA
SWARAJ: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Village Public Telephones
(VPTs) are being installed in villages under
Bharat Nirman Programme;
(b) if so, the target fixed in this regard;
and
(c) the number of villages where Village
Public Telephones have been installed till
March, 2007?
Houses to poor under VAMBAY in
Nagpur
†*419. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION  be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of economically weaker
people of Nagpur who have been allotted
houses so far under 'Valmiki Ambedkar
Awas Yojna' (VAMBAY);
(b) whether it is a fact that there are
people who have not so far been allotted
houses under the said scheme;
(c) if so, the reasons for not allotting
houses to such people; and
(d) by when people of very poor
economic categories would be allotted
houses?
Slum population in urban cities
*420. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION  be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the slum population in urban cities is
increasing rapidly with nearly one third of
the urban population being poor;
(b) whether Government are also aware
that this population is away from basic
health facilities compared to rural areas;
(c) if so, the schemes of Government to
help poor slum population;
(d) whether there is any specific fund
granted to State Governments to improve
living condition of slum population and to
eradicate poverty that has engulfed them;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday,  the May 3, 2007/Vaisakha 13, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Coal; Communications and
Information Technology; Development of North Eastern Region;
External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Overseas
Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances
and Pensions; Planning; Shipping, Road Transport and
Highways, Space; Statistics and Programme
Implementation; Urban Development;
Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 155
704
Augmentation of India's nuclear
power capacity
3037. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Uranium Corporation of
India Limited (UCIL) proposes to start
uranium mining in Meghalaya to augment
India's installed nuclear power capacity
upto 20,000 MW by 2020;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action plan of Government to
protect environment as a result thereof?
Shortage of uranium deposits
3038. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the steps which Government are
considering to overcome the acute shortage
of uranium deposit in the country;
(b) whether it is high time to vigorously
make efforts to explore new uranium
deposits in the country which US may
exploit through nuclear deal to push its long
standing non-proliferation agenda; and
(c) the steps which are being taken to
face the situation?
Uranium exploration
3039. SHRI P.R. RAJAN: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are stepping
up the Uranium exploration and mining;
and
(b) if so, whether foreign private
companies are being delegated to do this
work?
Enhancement of nuclear power
generation
3040. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) what steps have been taken to

705
enhance power generation in the country
through nuclear power;
(b) how India stands vis-a-vis other
Asian countries as far as total power
generation in the nuclear field is concerned;
(c) whether private sector is being
encouraged and provided incentives to go
in for private projects in the field of nuclear
power generation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Exploration and research in atomic
minerals
3041. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up any high powered committee under the
Chairmanship of Cabinet Secretary to
oversee statutory clearance by State and
Central authorities with regard to
exploration and research pertaining to
atomic minerals including nuclear raw
materials;
(b) whether it is a fact that Atomic
Mineral Directorate (AMD) is responsible
for identifying exploration and research
relating to atomic minerals, which is the
first step required in India's Nuclear Fuel
Cycle; and
(c) if so, the progress so far made in this
regard?
Violation of safety rules
3042. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that safety rules
are not being followed properly by the
Ministry of Coal in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have
conducted any investigations and
inspection in this regard;
(d) if so, the details thereof and when;
(e) the authorities which have been held
responsible for not adhering to the safety
rules properly;
(f) the details thereof during the last
three years, including the action taken
against the erring authorities year-wise; and
(g) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation of coal from nearby coal
mines
3043. SHRI KESHUBHAI S.
PATEL:
SHRI JAYANTILAL
BAROT:
SHRI SURENDRA
MOTILAL PATEL:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the State of Gujarat is
getting coal for power generation from coal
field located far away, with the result the
freight cost of coal is higher than the actual
cost of the coal;
(b) whether Government are considering
to allocate coal from the nearby coal mines;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?

706
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Illegal coal mining in different coal
fields
†3044. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the incidents
of illegal mining are taking place in different
coal fields in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the action taken against those
responsible for this?
Ensuring safety in coal mines
3045. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that many coal
mines are functioning against the advice of
the Directorate General of Mines Safety
and the number of such mines which are
under public sector undertakings; and
(b) if so, the details of such mines and
the steps which are being taken to ensure
safety of such mines?
Low procurement of coal in power
generation
†3046. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the utilization
of coal by the power generation sector has
been reducing for the last few years in the
country;
(b) if so, the facts thereof and the
quantity of coal purchased by the said
sector from the Coal India Ltd. (CIL) during
the years 2004-05, 2005-06 and 2006-07;
(c) whether the said quantity is less than
the annual quantity of estimated annual sale;
and
(d) if so, the facts thereof and the
reasons for less procurement of coal in the
power generation sector?
Pilferage of coal
3047. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
there is a large scale pilferage of coal in the
Public Sector Coal Companies due to the
mafia operations and other illegal activities;
(b) if so, the estimated loss incurred by
these companies during the last three years,
company-wise and mine-wise;
(c) whether Government have
conducted any enquiry in this regard; and
(d) if so, the details of the findings?
Fixing of coal royalty
†3048. SHRI SHREEGOPAL VYAS:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
refer to the answer to Unstarred Question
2417 given in the Rajya Sabha on the 14th
December, 2006 and state:
(a) whether any decision has been taken
with regard to suggestions submitted by
Chhattisgarh and other States in respect of
fixing of royalty on the basis of market price;

707
(b) if not, the reasons for delay in taking
the decision; and
(c) in what manner the loses being
suffered by the States due to this would be
compensated?
Transportation of coal by ex-
servicemen companies
3049. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the coal in some subsidiaries
of Coal India Limited is being transported
through the companies owned by the ex-
servicemen;
(b) if so, the total transportation amount
paid to these companies owned by the ex-
servicemen during the financial year 2005-
06;
(c) the approximate excess amount paid
to the companies owned by the ex-
servicemen by the Coal India Limited, in
comparison to the amount paid to civilian
companies; and
(d) whether Ministry of Defence has
reimbursed the said losses suffered by the
Coal India Limited as the said scheme has
been proposed by the Ministry of
Defence?
Illegal mining of coal
3050. MS. MABEL REBELLO: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the quantity of coal which is daily
mined illegally and sent to different parts
of the country on regular basis;
(b) in what way, Government propose
to break this nexus of coal miners, coal
transporters and traders; and
(c) the estimated loss per annum to
Government due to illegal mining?
Open cast coal mines
3051. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the increasing number of open cast coal
mines in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government have
framed any rules and regulations in this
regard; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Merger of MTNL and BSNL
3052. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the proposal of merger of
MTNL and BSNL is under consideration
of Government;
(b) if not, the reasons therefor in view
of consolidation taking place in the sector;
(c) if so, by when and the issues which
have yet not been resolved; and
(d) by when Government are likely to
finalize its view on the issue?
Quality of telecom services in
Orissa
3053. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's

708
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
wireless base would cross forty crore
by 2010;
(b) if so, what would be the share of
Orissa out of this; and
(c) the action plan of Government to
improve the quality of telecom services in
the State of Orissa?
Recent orders of TRAI
3054. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made an
assessment of the financial implications for
BSNL due to recent orders of TRAI during
the last three months;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such financial implications
would adversely affect the future
development plan of BSNL; and
(d) if so, in what way the BSNL
proposes to overcome the financial impact
of TRAI order?
Submarine Cable Landing Station in
West Bengal
3055. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to refer to the answer to Unstarred
Question 1649 given in the Rajya Sabha on
the 7th December, 2006 and state:
(a) the present status of the
implementation of the approved Submarine
Cable Landing Station in West Bengal;
(b) the details of the total project cost
of the above project; and
(c) the date of completion of the same?
Mobile services in rural areas of
Uttarakhand
†3056. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of availability of
mobile services in various districts of
Uttarakhand;
(b) whether it is proposed to set up
intensive tower network in rural areas in
order to expand the areas coming under
mobile service; and
(c) if so, the number of towers and
locations thereof to be installed in various
districts of Uttarakhand?
Extension of Speed Post services in
A.P.
3057. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Speed Post
is expecting to increase its revenue to the
tune of Rs. 500 crores for 2006-07 from
Rs. 408 crores in 2005-06;
(b) if so, whether it is possible to extend
Speed Post services in 18 more cities of the
country to tap the market;
(c) if so, the details of the 18 cities to
which Speed Post has been extended;

709
(d) whether any new cities are proposed
to be added in the State of Andhra Pradesh;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the steps his Ministry is taking to
increase the market share from the present
27 per cent to 35 per cent by 2008?
Telephone exchanges in Jharkhand
†3058. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) the installed capacity of telephone
exchanges in Jharkhand;
(b) the extent of their capacity
utilisation each year during the last five
years;
(c) the extent of loss of revenue
consequent upon under-utilisation of the
capacity, if any; and
(d) the reasons for under-utilisation of
the capacity?
Implementation of mobile number
portability
3059. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
recommendations of TRAI regarding
implementation of mobile number
portability is being opposed by large mobile
operators such as BSNL, Bharti and Hutch
etc;
(b) the steps taken by TRAI to facilitate
introduction of this consumer friendly
measure in the mobile service sector;
(c) the reasons for rejection of
recommendations of TRAI regarding
implementation of mobile number
portability by Government;
(d) whether TRAI plans to undertake a
consultation process once again on the
implementation of mobile number
portability; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Menace of marketing calls
3060. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that TRAI has
not taken any steps to prevent the menace
of marketing calls despite instructions of
Hon'ble Supreme Court in a Public Interest
Litigation;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Cellular
Operators have breached the right to
privacy of their consumers; and
(c) if so, the corrective action taken by
TRAI?
Amendment of IT Act, 2000
3061. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has initiated a
number of measures for the amendment to
the Information Technology Act, 2000,
where a provision for setting up a mandate
for critical infrastructure sector such as
telecom, transport, banks, power, defence,
aviation and railways would be mandated
to secure their information technology
system and network;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

710
(b) if so, whether any concrete measures
in this regard have been discussed; and
(c) if so, by when the Bill for amending
the Information Technology Act is likely
to be introduced?
Connection of horizontal offices in
districts and talukas
3062. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
consideration for Non-Exchange Line to
connect horizontal offices in districts and
